description: React component for a flow diagram editor using ReactFlow, managing chatflow nodes and edges, with API interactions, state management, and UI controls.

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: Handles creation of new edges between nodes, updating node inputs accordingly.

methods.name: handleLoadFlow
methods.description: Loads flow data from JSON string into nodes and edges state.

methods.name: handleDeleteFlow
methods.description: Confirms and deletes the current chatflow, navigating away afterward.

methods.name: handleSaveFlow
methods.description: Saves the current flow state as a new or existing chatflow via API.

methods.name: onNodeClick
methods.description: Handles node selection and visual state update.

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default drag over behavior for drop zones.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles dropping new nodes onto the flow canvas, initializing their position and data.

methods.name: syncNodes
methods.description: Synchronizes nodes with component definitions, updating outdated nodes and edges.

methods.name: saveChatflowSuccess
methods.description: Displays success snackbar after saving chatflow.

methods.name: setDirty
methods.description: Marks the flow as having unsaved changes.

methods.name: checkIfUpsertAvailable
methods.description: Checks if upsert button should be enabled based on nodes and edges.

methods.name: checkIfSyncNodesAvailable
methods.description: Checks if sync nodes button should be enabled based on component node versions.
